name: Gabumon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal 3 cards from the top of your Deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Garurumon] in its name (other than [KendoGarurumon]) and 1 Digimon card with [Omnimon] in its name among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
set_name: PB-13: Digimon Card Game Royal Knights Binder Set
